description: Check a whole list in one call: a bibliography or a dependency manifest. Send items[] of {tool, input} or the citations[]/packages[] shorthand. Up to 12 items at a flat US$0.12 on this door; longer lists pay 0.016667 an item on the pack-funded HTTP door (POST /bulk, up to 25 items). Every item is answered by the same door that answers a single call, so the verdicts cannot disagree. This door takes a LIST of references or package versions, not prose: to check the claims inside a document, use check_document, and to check one reference use verify_citation or verify_package. Comes with an Ed25519-signed receipt covering the question, the verdict, the sources and the time, checkable offline against the published key at /.well-known/factstamp-issuer.json — so the check itself can be audited later by someone who was not here.

citations.description: Shorthand: DOIs, arXiv IDs or titles, each checked as a citation.

items.description: Explicit form: each item names its door and its input.

name: verify_bulk
